layer_1_macro.assessment: Macro backdrop supportive: equities remain cheap vs bank deposits (3.2pp spread). Safe-haven flows into gold reflect risk-off, but VND depreciation pressure partially offsets foreign inflows. VN market positioned for selective opportunities amid macro caution.

layer_2_fii_flows.assessment: FII sentiment mixed. Banking sector diverging - VCB maintains pricing power as strong credit provider, while weaker names face margin pressure. Risk-off flows support defensive sectors.

layer_3_asset_allocation.signal: VN-Index gains despite majority stock decline
layer_3_asset_allocation.assessment: Market breadth deteriorating. VN-Index climbs on large-cap carry while 60% of stocks decline. This concentration pattern amplifies tail risk in index sell-off scenarios.

layer_5_conviction.sector_conviction: Banking HOLD, Tech HOLD-REDUCE, Real-estate CAUTION
layer_5_conviction.risk_chains: Macro contradiction solvable via quality selection

market_message: Vietnamese equities trade in risk-off mode as gold climbs and broad participation narrows. Large-cap support masks deteriorating breadth. Banking sector credit quality diverging: Vietcombank maintains defensive positioning with ROE 16.7%. FPT benefits from US Treasury yield decline supporting IT services demand. Real-estate valuations stretched. Equity earnings yield 8.2% significantly exceeds bank deposits 5% - a 3.2pp spread signals relative value. Conviction: HOLD quality (VCB, FPT); AVOID stretched (DXG); monitor sector consolidation risk.
